Snacks

Banana oat biscuits

Banános keksz

6 months+ Sound idea 18 min 8 portions

Serve a soft piece that squashes between finger and thumb. Do not bake them crisp.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 medium Ripe banana (Mashed smooth)
  • 80 g Rolled oats (Fine or ordinary)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mash the banana and stir in the oats.
  3. Press the mix flat in small rounds.
  4. Bake until set but still soft, about 10 minutes.
  5. Cool and serve before they dry out.

Sound idea

A biscuit baked until hard can snap into difficult pieces. Sugar is not needed with a ripe banana.

Mash banana with oats, press the mix flat, and bake it soft.
